titulo_fr: La grammaire au service du sens : Observer les formes
titulo_es: Grammar at the service of meaning: Vocabulary and forms
intro: Interprets earlier, hypotheses and valuation by the chosen verbal form. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Interprets earlier, hypotheses and valuation by the chosen verbal form. It distinguishes statements, evidence and reservations; it attributes each data to its source before making a conclusion.
Point of attention: It recognizes what fact precedes another, whether the author poses a possibility and what verb the subjunctive governs. In this fragment, «rapport» means «report».

frases.fr: Le rapport, qui avait été rédigé avant la consultation, sera complété par une annexe.
frases.es: El informe, que se había redactado antes de la consulta, se completará con un anexo.
frases.en: The report, which had been prepared before the consultation, will be supplemented by an annex.

frases.fr: Si le financement était confirmé, les travaux pourraient commencer dès le mois de juin.
frases.es: Si se confirmara la financiación, las obras podrían comenzar en junio mismo.
frases.en: If funding was confirmed, the work could begin in June itself.
